title: Hospital Escuela salary protest/strike continues into November
notes: HRN says on 1 Nov it is the second day and the work stoppage began the prior day; Hondudiario on 4 Nov says several days of stoppage continued. El Heraldo on 22 Nov reports a meeting/asambleas and says the boulevard blockade occurred three weeks earlier, without establishing a new street gathering on 22 Nov. No November event duplicated.
open_questions: Was there a fresh street gathering after 1 Nov? Search result/body dated 22 Nov does not establish one.
Do not attribute the nearby 1 Nov gunshots to state actors; participants attributed them to opponents.
